chapter: New Orleans clubs and Sharky's band
title: The Red Carpet club
summary: Describes the Red Carpet membership club on Common Street, where he met Jim Garrison, and the loan he never got back.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Back to that, that was the red carpet club? Yeah, the red carpet.
It was on, on, uh, the first street off of. Common. It's on Common Street, yeah, right across from the old St. Charles Hotel. And, uh. From the side entrance to the old St. Charles Hotel.
Was it a, uh, open to the public or not?
Oh, yes, but you had to have a membership.
It was a $3 bill if ever was one in this world. stuff
I loaned him $800 to try to keep his doors open, and he never did pay me back.
Did you ever work in any key clubs where you had to have a key to get in?
No, and didn't want to, but I never was offered one.
I just wondered, I had private clubs like that.
